_comment: Wireless Layer C intake. Copy this file, fill it from the client's wireless-controller export or console (Cisco WLC/9800, Aruba, Meraki, UniFi, Ruckus, etc.), then run Extensions\WirelessControllerImport.py. This is a configuration review, not a live connection. Allowed values: purpose = corporate|guest|iot|voice|byod|other ; security = open|wep|wpa-psk|wpa2-psk|wpa3-psk|wpa2-enterprise|wpa3-enterprise|wpa2/wpa3-mixed ; pmf = disabled|optional|required ; vlan = integer or null ; client_isolation = true|false|null.
source_position: Client wireless controller configuration export, dated YYYY-MM-DD
